BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH
Zhiyu Wang

EDUCATION:

Shandong Medical College, Jinan, PRC M.D. 1983 Public Health
Shandong Medical College, Jinan, PRC M.P.H. 1972 Microbiology and Immunology

EMPLOYMENT:

1993 - 1994 Fellow of World Health Organization University of Massachusetts Medical School

1993 - Present Associate Professor and Deputy Director, Department of Virology, Shandong Medical University, Jinan, Peoples Republic of China

1990 - 1993 Lecturer, Department of Virology,
Shandong Medical University, Jinan, Peoples Republic of China

1986 - 1990 Assistant, Department of Virology,
Shandong Medical University, Jinan, Peoples Republic of China
(Duties in all the above positions were research and teaching in Virology.)

AWARDS AND HONORS:

Eight at provincial level.

ACADEMIC ORGANIZATIONS:

Member, Medical Association of China
Member, Chinese Association of Preventive Medicine
Member, Microbiological Association of China

PUBLICATIONS (selected from a total of 23 peer-reviewed publications):

1. Wang Zhiyu and Han Shijie. 1986. Tryptic Peptide Map Analysis of Structural Polypeptides of Different Rubella Virus Strains. Acta Academiae Medicinae Shandong 24(3): 11-15.

2. Wang Zhiyu. 1986. Molecular Biology of Rubella Virus. Foreign Medical Sciences (Microbiology Branch) 9(4): 153-157.

3. Han Shijie and Wang Zhiyu. 1986. A Comparison of Structural Polypeptides of Different Rubella Virus Strains by SDS-PAGE. Acta Academiae Medicinae Shandong 24(3): 6-10(15).

4. Wang Zhiyu and Han Shijie. 1987. Biological Properties of Isolated Rubella Virus Strain JR23. Acta Academiae Medicinae Shandong 25(4) 50-53.
